naming.rb:275 `ActiveModel::Name.new(self, namespace)` derives the bare name and namespace from the Ruby constant path. A JS class carries no module path, so trails' `ModelName(name, { klass, namespace })` takes the demodulized name and the `moduleName` carrier explicitly (see the block comment at model.ts:1532). Language shortcoming; the namespace-carrier design, not the call, is what would have to change.
